text: The Patriots head into Sunday's Week 5 matchup against the Raiders significantly undermanned in the secondary, with starting cornerbacks Christian Gonzalez (shoulder) and Carlton Davis III (neck) both ruled out—a particularly thorny problem when facing Kirk Cousins, who's been one of the season's biggest surprises through four games. There's some positive injury news on the offensive side, as Rhamondre Stevenson has returned to practice, though six Patriots players overall won't make the trip to Vegas. On the brighter side, the Patriots' edge rusher trio of Dre'Mont Jones, Elijah Ponder, and rookie Gabe Jacas has been exceeding expectations early in the season, and the team will honor Adam Vinatieri's Pro Football Hall of Fame induction during halftime with a ceremony that'll stream live on Patriots.com. The squad will also don throwback uniforms for the occasion, adding some pageantry to what shapes up as a defensive chess match against a hot Raiders offense.
